metadata.title: Monochrome Cinematic Portrait with Diagonal Shadow

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome close-up portrait featuring a subject in a wide-brimmed hat with a sharp diagonal shadow bisecting the face.
triggerTerms: monochrome close-up portrait with diagonal hat shadow
grainy black and white 1970s album cover style
high-key facial lighting with deep hat brim shadow
excludeWhen: modern high-definition digital clarity is needed

recipe.visualDefinition: An extreme close-up of a face, tilted slightly, where a dark diagonal shadow from a hat brim cuts across the upper right quadrant, leaving one eye visible and the lower face in soft, high-key light.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal shadow line vs. vertical facial orientation
High-key skin tones vs. deep black hat and shadow
Soft hair texture vs. sharp geometric shadow edge
coreInvariants: Diagonal shadow bisecting the forehead and one eye

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, face occupies 80% of the frame, tilted approximately 15 degrees.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The visible eye, positioned near the center-top of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal line of the hat brim from top-right down toward the mouth.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal, confined to the dark areas of the hat and the deep shadow.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white (highlights on lips and eyes)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between lit skin and shadowed hat.

letterConstructionRules: Placed within a small rectangular or angled frame
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uniform stroke weight with rounded terminals to mimic ink bleed
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for all metadata to maintain a utilitarian, 'stamped' look.
graphicDevices: Thin border lines around text block

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the utilitarian, mid-century grotesque feel.
Provides the necessary compact structure and clean lines.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, black and white extreme close-up of a person's face tilted slightly, wearing a dark fedora that casts a sharp diagonal shadow over the upper right side of the face, leaving one eye visible.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add small, uppercase sans-serif text in the top-left corner, tilted at a slight angle, encased in a thin rectangular frame with a stamped ink texture.

verificationChecks: Is the diagonal shadow from the hat sharp and prominent?
Is the text small and confined to the top-left corner?

adjustableVariables: Contrast level between skin and shadow

mustAchieve: High-key lighting on the lower face

postGenerationChecks: Check for visible film grain across mid-tones
Ensure the diagonal shadow edge is clean but not digitally perfect
Verify the eye is the primary focal point despite the shadow
Confirm text is small and tilted in the corner
recipe.reuseFormula: Extreme Close-up + Monochrome + Diagonal Hat Shadow + Corner Stamped Typography
